nodes.name: Every 10m
nodes.notes: ADR-066 Block 4: health dead-man's-switch for the always-on session-waiter service (http://session-waiter:8080). Pings GET /health every 10 min so a crashed/wedged/unreachable waiter — which once the managed lane runs through it would silently orphan EVERY long-running session — is caught within ~10 min. Mirrors Image MCP Health Monitor (v1).

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test entry for DoD verification via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs (a Schedule Trigger cannot be fired over the n8n API). No inputs needed.

nodes.name: Probe Session Waiter
nodes.notes: GET the session-waiter /health on the internal network. 2xx (ok:true) -> Healthy; any non-2xx or network error (container down / wedged / not deployed) routes to the error output (onError) -> CRITICAL. Cheap endpoint, 10s timeout is ample.

nodes.name: Healthy
nodes.notes: Terminal for the healthy path. Silent on purpose — a healthy probe must NOT post to the Alerts task every 10 min.

nodes.name: Alert Waiter Down
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025) when the probe returns non-2xx or the endpoint is unreachable. Means the session-waiter container is down/wedged/not deployed. Fix: ssh the VPS, docker ps/docker logs session-waiter, docker compose up -d session-waiter.
